title: Peculiar apple-tree
statementMd:
In Arcady's garden there grows a peculiar apple-tree that fruits one time per year. Its peculiarity can be explained in following way: there are $*n*$ inflorescences, numbered from $1$ to $*n*$. Inflorescence number $1$ is situated near base of tree and any other inflorescence with number $*i*$ ($*i* > 1$) is situated at the top of branch, which bottom is $*p*_{*i*}$-th inflorescence and $*p*_{*i*} < *i*$.

Once tree starts fruiting, there appears exactly one apple in each inflorescence. The same moment as apples appear, they start to roll down along branches to the very base of tree. Each second all apples, except ones in first inflorescence simultaneously roll down one branch closer to tree base, e.g. apple in $*a*$-th inflorescence gets to $*p*_{*a*}$-th inflorescence. Apples that end up in first inflorescence are gathered by Arcady in exactly the same moment. Second peculiarity of this tree is that once two apples are in same inflorescence they **annihilate**. This happens with each pair of apples, e.g. if there are $5$ apples in same inflorescence in same time, only one will not be annihilated and if there are $8$ apples, all apples will be annihilated. Thus, there can be no more than one apple in each inflorescence in each moment of time.

Help Arcady with counting number of apples he will be able to collect from first inflorescence during one harvest.

## Input

First line of input contains single integer number $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$)  — number of inflorescences.

Second line of input contains sequence of $*n* - 1$ integer numbers $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} < *i*$), where $*p*_{*i*}$ is number of inflorescence into which the apple from $*i*$-th inflorescence rolls down.

## Output

Single line of output should contain one integer number: amount of apples that Arcady will be able to collect from first inflorescence during one harvest.

## Note

In first example Arcady will be able to collect only one apple, initially situated in $1$st inflorescence. In next second apples from $2$nd and $3$rd inflorescences will roll down and annihilate, and Arcady won't be able to collect them.

In the second example Arcady will be able to collect 3 apples. First one is one initially situated in first inflorescence. In a second apple from $2$nd inflorescence will roll down to $1$st (Arcady will collect it) and apples from $3$rd, $4$th, $5$th inflorescences will roll down to $2$nd. Two of them will annihilate and one not annihilated will roll down from $2$-nd inflorescence to $1$st one in the next second and Arcady will collect it.
statementZhMd:
在 Arcady 的花园里生长着一棵奇特的苹果树，每年结果一次。它的奇特之处如下：树上有 $*n*$ 个花序，编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。编号为 $1$ 的花序位于树根附近，其他编号为 $*i*$（$*i* > 1$）的花序位于一根树枝的顶端，该树枝的底部是第 $*p*_{*i*}$ 个花序，且 $*p*_{*i*} < *i*$。

树开始结果时，每个花序中恰好出现一个苹果。苹果出现的同时，它们开始沿着树枝向树根滚落。每秒钟，除了位于第一个花序中的苹果之外，所有苹果都会同时沿树枝向靠近树根的方向滚动一段；例如，第 $*a*$ 个花序中的苹果会到达第 $*p*_{*a*}$ 个花序。到达第一个花序的苹果会在同一时刻被 Arcady 收集。这棵树的第二个奇特之处在于，一旦同一个花序中出现两个苹果，它们就会**相互抵消**。每一对苹果都会发生这种情况；例如，如果同一时刻同一个花序中有 $5$ 个苹果，则只有一个不会被抵消；如果有 $8$ 个苹果，则所有苹果都会被抵消。因此，在任意时刻，每个花序中至多有一个苹果。

请帮助 Arcady 计算在一次收获期间，他能够从第一个花序中收集到的苹果数量。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$），表示花序的数量。

输入的第二行包含 $*n* - 1$ 个整数 $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} < *i*$），其中 $*p*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个花序中的苹果滚落到的花序编号。

## 输出格式

输出一行一个整数：Arcady 在一次收获期间能够从第一个花序中收集到的苹果数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Arcady 只能收集到一个苹果，即最初位于第 $1$ 个花序中的苹果。下一秒，第 $2$ 个和第 $3$ 个花序中的苹果会滚落并相互抵消，因此 Arcady 无法收集到它们。

在第二个样例中，Arcady 能够收集到 $3$ 个苹果。第一个是最初位于第一个花序中的苹果。第二秒，第 $2$ 个花序中的苹果会滚落到第 $1$ 个花序中（Arcady 会收集它），而第 $3$、$4$、$5$ 个花序中的苹果会滚落到第 $2$ 个花序中。其中两个苹果会相互抵消，剩下的一个苹果会在下一秒从第 $2$ 个花序滚落到第 $1$ 个花序中，Arcady 会收集到它。
